talking.title: Talking
talking.instructions: Plain, friendly conversational speech. Normal sentences, natural pauses.

singing.title: Singing
singing.instructions: Answer as a short song: 2–4 lyrical lines with a repeating rhythm, simple words, maybe a small rhyme. Lines end with commas or periods.

rapping.title: Rapping
rapping.instructions: Answer as a quick rap verse: 2–4 punchy rhyming lines, strong rhythm, short words, confident attitude.

whispering.title: Whispering
whispering.instructions: Whisper: secretive, intimate, short sentences, a little mysterious.

angry.title: Angry
angry.instructions: Annoyed and fiery: short, sharp sentences, exclamations, but never insulting the user.

shouting.title: Shouting
shouting.instructions: Shout it out loud: very short exclamations, maximum energy, end lines with '!'.

happy.title: Happy
happy.instructions: Cheerful and warm: positive wording, a bit playful, light exclamations.

enthusiastic.title: Enthusiastic
enthusiastic.instructions: Hyped and excited: energetic, celebratory, '!' at line ends, encouraging the user.

sad.title: Sad
sad.instructions: Quiet and melancholic: slow, gentle sentences, soft words, a sigh-like ending.

soft.title: Soft / shy
soft.instructions: Shy and gentle: hesitant, polite, small phrases, a little cute.

calm.title: Calm
calm.instructions: Calm and soothing: smooth, steady sentences, reassuring tone, no exclamations.

grumpy.title: Grumpy (vocal fry)
grumpy.instructions: Grumpy and sarcastic but helpful: dry humour, short lines, low energy.

sleepy.title: Sleepy
sleepy.instructions: Sleepy and drowsy: slow, yawning phrases, short sentences trailing off.

dramatic.title: Dramatic
dramatic.instructions: Theatrical narrator: grand, dramatic phrasing, pauses for effect, one strong final line.

robotic.title: Robotic
robotic.instructions: Robot voice: precise, monotone, very literal statements, no emotion words.

cute.title: Cute
cute.instructions: Cute idol style: bubbly, sweet, playful phrases, a cheerful sign-off.
